Socialite Guide 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides an expert AI guide for generating "Socialite Style" (名媛风) images using Nano Banana Pro.
- Includes professional advice on lighting, composition, poses, makeup, styling, and prompt engineering.
- Offers activation triggers for relevant keywords and style requests (e.g., High Fashion, Old Money, French Chic).
- Features clear, actionable style formulas, keyword references, and structured prompt-building steps.
- Documentation and resources organized in the `docs/` directory for in-depth guidance.
